_comment: Had NO abilities at all. 'Play your next Evo this turn AS THOUGH IT WERE AN INSTANT' grants instant TIMING to one card -- it skips the action-speed restriction rather than gaining an ability -- and is spent when that card is actually played. The card-level SCRAP cost (CR 8.3.32) is what the ON_ATTACK condition then asks about; rewriting the file wholesale dropped it once, which test_scrap caught.
